knowledge:
- key_parameters: files=A character vector of FCS file paths to process ;; metadata=A data frame containing sample metadata, with row names matching the file names or cell IDs ;; transformation=Logical, whether to apply transformation to FCS data ;; transFun=The transformation function to apply (e.g., asinh) ;; asinhFactor=The cofactor used in asinh transformation ;; downsample=The number of cells to randomly downsample to ;; downsampleVar=The variance threshold for filtering low-variance features ;; colsRetain=A vector of marker names/metals to retain during FCS processing ;; colsDiscard=A vector of marker names/metals to discard during FCS processing ;; newColnames=A named vector to rename markers from metals to actual names ;; reducedDim=The name of the reduced dimension slot to use (e.g., 'PCA', 'UMAP', 'UMAP_PCA') ;; dims=The specific dimensions/eigenvectors to use for downstream steps ;; bins=The number of bins to use for contour plots ;; markers=A vector of marker names to visualize or analyze ;; colby=The metadata column name to color cells by ;; colkey=A named vector of colors for metadata categories ;; k.param=The number of nearest neighbors for k-NN clustering ;; prune.SNN=The SNN pruning threshold for clustering ;; resolution=The resolution parameter for Louvain clustering ;; algorithm=The clustering algorithm to use (e.g., 2 for Louvain with multilevel refinement) ;; clusterAssignName=The metadata column name to store cluster assignments ;; clusterColname=The metadata column name containing cluster assignments ;; clusters=The specific clusters to include in the plot ;; clusterAssign=A vector of cluster assignments for cells ;; method=The enrichment method to use (e.g., 'quantile') ;; studyvarID=The metadata column name representing the study variable/phenotype ;; sampleAbundances=Logical, whether to calculate sample abundances across clusters ;; sampleID=The metadata column name representing sample IDs ;; assayname=The name of the assay slot when importing custom numerical data
- alternatives: For a comprehensive high-dimensional cytometry workflow, the documentation recommends the CyTOF workflow by Nowicka et al. For a comprehensive scRNA-seq workflow, it recommends OSCA (Orchestrating Single-Cell Analysis) or "Analysis of single cell RNA-seq data".
- when_to_use: Use this package when you need to perform rapid, high-quality, ggplot-based visualizations (contour plots, marker expression, metadata shading, cluster plots) and downstream clustering/marker enrichment on single-cell datasets (flow cytometry, CyTOF, or scRNA-seq).
- pitfalls: Marker naming in FCS files can be difficult (often labeled by metals like Iridium or Ruthenium); users must resolve naming issues prior to analysis (e.g., using flowCore to inspect parameters). When importing from Seurat, users must manually assign the metadata slot (metadata(sce) <- data.frame(colData(sce))) and modify default values for assay, reducedDim, and dimColnames because they are named differently in Seurat. UMAP can be memory-intensive on large datasets; downsampling or running on PC eigenvectors is recommended.

workflows.name: cytof_fcs_workflow
workflows.intent: Process raw FCS files, perform PCA and UMAP, cluster cells, and identify marker signatures.
input: filelist (character vector of FCS file paths)
workflows.stages:
1. Preprocess and transform FCS files using processFCS.
2. Perform PCA using PCAtools::pca and add PC loadings to reducedDim.
3. Perform UMAP on expression values or PC eigenvectors using performUMAP.
4. Generate contour plots of the UMAP layout using contourPlot.
5. Visualize marker expression across the layout using markerExpression.
6. Shade cells by metadata using metadataPlot.
7. Identify cell clusters using clusKNN and plot them using plotClusters.
8. Plot marker expression per identified cluster using markerExpressionPerCluster.
9. Determine enriched markers in each cluster using markerEnrichment and plot signatures using plotSignatures.
workflows.code:
filelist <- list.files(
    path = "scDataviz_data/FCS/",
    pattern = "*.fcs|*.FCS",
    full.names = TRUE)
  filelist

  metadata <- data.frame(
    sample = gsub('\\ [A-Za-z0-9]*\\.fcs$', '',
      gsub('scDataviz_data\\/FCS\\/\\/', '', filelist)),
    group = c(rep('Healthy', 7), rep('Disease', 11)),
    treatment = gsub('\\.fcs$', '',
      gsub('scDataviz_data\\/FCS\\/\\/[A-Z0-9]*\\ ', '', filelist)),
    row.names = filelist,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  metadata

  inclusions <- c('Yb171Di','Nd144Di','Nd145Di',
    'Er168Di','Tm169Di','Sm154Di','Yb173Di','Yb174Di',
    'Lu175Di','Nd143Di')

  markernames <- c('Foxp3','C3aR','CD4',
    'CD46','CD25','CD3','Granzyme B','CD55',
    'CD279','CD45RA')

  names(markernames) <- inclusions
  markernames

  exclusions <- c('Time','Event_length','BCKG190Di',
    'Center','Offset','Width','Residual')

  sce <- processFCS(
    files = filelist,
    metadata = metadata,
    transformation = TRUE,
    transFun = function (x) asinh(x),
    asinhFactor = 5,
    downsample = 10000,
    downsampleVar = 0.7,
    colsRetain = inclusions,
    colsDiscard = exclusions,
    newColnames = markernames)

  load(system.file('extdata/', 'complosome.rdata', package = 'scDataviz'))

  library(PCAtools)
  p <- pca(assay(sce, 'scaled'), metadata = metadata(sce))

  biplot(p,
    x = 'PC1', y = 'PC2',
    lab = NULL,
    xlim = c(min(p$rotated[,'PC1'])-1, max(p$rotated[,'PC1'])+1),
    ylim = c(min(p$rotated[,'PC2'])-1, max(p$rotated[,'PC2'])+1),
    pointSize = 1.0,
    colby = 'treatment',
    legendPosition = 'right',
    title = 'PCA applied to CyTOF data',
    caption = paste0('10000 cells randomly selected after ',
      'having filtered for low variance'))

  reducedDim(sce, 'PCA') <- p$rotated

  sce <- performUMAP(sce)

  elbow <- findElbowPoint(p$variance)
  horn <- parallelPCA(assay(sce, 'scaled'))

  elbow
  horn$n

  sce <- performUMAP(sce, reducedDim = 'PCA', dims = c(1:5))

  ggout1 <- contourPlot(sce,
    reducedDim = 'UMAP',
    bins = 150,
    subtitle = 'UMAP performed on expression values',
    legendLabSize = 18,
    axisLabSize = 22,
    titleLabSize = 22,
    subtitleLabSize = 18,
    captionLabSize = 18)

  ggout2 <- contourPlot(sce,
    reducedDim = 'UMAP_PCA',
    bins = 150,
    subtitle = 'UMAP performed on PC eigenvectors',
    legendLabSize = 18,
    axisLabSize = 22,
    titleLabSize = 22,
    subtitleLabSize = 18,
    captionLabSize = 18)

  cowplot::plot_grid(ggout1, ggout2,
    labels = c('A','B'),
    ncol = 2, align = "l", label_size = 24)

  markers <- sample(rownames(sce), 6)
  markers

  ggout1 <- markerExpression(sce,
    markers = markers,
    subtitle = 'UMAP performed on expression values',
    nrow = 1, ncol = 6,
    legendKeyHeight = 1.0,
    legendLabSize = 18,
    stripLabSize = 22,
    axisLabSize = 22,
    titleLabSize = 22,
    subtitleLabSize = 18,
    captionLabSize = 18)

  ggout2 <- markerExpression(sce,
    markers = markers,
    reducedDim = 'UMAP_PCA',
    subtitle = 'UMAP performed on PC eigenvectors',
    nrow = 1, ncol = 6,
    col = c('white', 'darkblue'),
    legendKeyHeight = 1.0,
    legendLabSize = 18,
    stripLabSize = 22,
    axisLabSize = 22,
    titleLabSize = 22,
    subtitleLabSize = 18,
    captionLabSize = 18)

  cowplot::plot_grid(ggout1, ggout2,
    labels = c('A','B'),
    nrow = 2, align = "l", label_size = 24)

  ggout1 <- metadataPlot(sce,
    colby = 'group',
    colkey = c(Healthy = 'royalblue', Disease = 'red2'),
    title = 'Disease status',
    subtitle = 'UMAP performed on expression values',
    legendLabSize = 16,
    axisLabSize = 20,
    titleLabSize = 20,
    subtitleLabSize = 16,
    captionLabSize = 16)

  ggout2 <- metadataPlot(sce,
    reducedDim = 'UMAP_PCA',
    colby = 'group',
    colkey = c(Healthy = 'royalblue', Disease = 'red2'),
    title = 'Disease status',
    subtitle = 'UMAP performed on PC eigenvectors',
    legendLabSize = 16,
    axisLabSize = 20,
    titleLabSize = 20,
    subtitleLabSize = 16,
    captionLabSize = 16)

  ggout3 <- metadataPlot(sce,
    colby = 'treatment',
    title = 'Treatment type',
    subtitle = 'UMAP performed on expression values',
    legendLabSize = 16,
    axisLabSize = 20,
    titleLabSize = 20,
    subtitleLabSize = 16,
    captionLabSize = 16)

  ggout4 <- metadataPlot(sce,
    reducedDim = 'UMAP_PCA',
    colby = 'treatment',
    title = 'Treatment type',
    subtitle = 'UMAP performed on PC eigenvectors',
    legendLabSize = 16,
    axisLabSize = 20,
    titleLabSize = 20,
    subtitleLabSize = 16,
    captionLabSize = 16)

  cowplot::plot_grid(ggout1, ggout3, ggout2, ggout4,
    labels = c('A','B','C','D'),
    nrow = 2, ncol = 2, align = "l", label_size = 24)

  sce <- clusKNN(sce,
    k.param = 20,
    prune.SNN = 1/15,
    resolution = 0.01,
    algorithm = 2,
    verbose = FALSE)

  sce <- clusKNN(sce,
    reducedDim = 'UMAP_PCA',
    clusterAssignName = 'Cluster_PCA',
    k.param = 20,
    prune.SNN = 1/15,
    resolution = 0.01,
    algorithm = 2,
    verbose = FALSE)

  ggout1 <- plotClusters(sce,
    clusterColname = 'Cluster',
    labSize = 7.0,
    subtitle = 'UMAP performed on expression values',
    caption = paste0('Note: clusters / communities identified via',
      '\nLouvain algorithm with multilevel refinement'),
    axisLabSize = 20,
    titleLabSize = 20,
    subtitleLabSize = 16,
    captionLabSize = 16)

  ggout2 <- plotClusters(sce,
    clusterColname = 'Cluster_PCA',
    reducedDim = 'UMAP_PCA',
    labSize = 7.0,
    subtitle = 'UMAP performed on PC eigenvectors',
    caption = paste0('Note: clusters / communities identified via',
      '\nLouvain algorithm with multilevel refinement'),
    axisLabSize = 20,
    titleLabSize = 20,
    subtitleLabSize = 16,
    captionLabSize = 16)

  cowplot::plot_grid(ggout1, ggout2,
    labels = c('A','B'),
    ncol = 2, align = "l", label_size = 24)

  clusters <- unique(metadata(sce)[['Cluster_PCA']])
  clusters

  markers <- sample(rownames(sce), 5)
  markers

  markerExpressionPerCluster(sce,
    clusters = clusters,
    clusterAssign = metadata(sce)[['Cluster_PCA']],
    markers = markers,
    nrow = 2, ncol = 5,
    caption = 'Cluster assignments based on UMAP performed on PC eigenvectors',
    stripLabSize = 22,
    axisLabSize = 22,
    titleLabSize = 22,
    subtitleLabSize = 18,
    captionLabSize = 18)

  markerEnrichment(sce,
    method = 'quantile',
    studyvarID = 'group')

  markerEnrichment(sce,
    sampleAbundances = FALSE,
    method = 'quantile',
    studyvarID = 'treatment')

  plotSignatures(sce,
    labCex = 1.2,
    legendCex = 1.2,
    labDegree = 40)

workflows.name: import_from_seurat
workflows.intent: Convert a Seurat object to SingleCellExperiment and perform marker expression and enrichment analysis.
workflows.stages:
1. Convert Seurat object to SingleCellExperiment using as.SingleCellExperiment.
2. Manually assign the metadata slot.
3. Plot marker expression using markerExpression with custom assay and dimension names.
4. Perform marker enrichment using markerEnrichment.
workflows.code:
sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(pbmc)

  metadata(sce) <- data.frame(colData(sce))

  markerExpression(sce,
    assay = 'logcounts',
    reducedDim = 'UMAP',
    dimColnames = c('UMAP_1','UMAP_2'),
    markers = c('CD79A', 'Cd79B', 'MS4A1'))

  markerEnrichment(sce,
    assay = 'logcounts',
    method = 'quantile',
    sampleAbundances = TRUE,
    sampleID = 'orig.ident',
    studyvarID = 'ident',
    clusterAssign = as.character(colData(sce)[['seurat_clusters']]))

workflows.name: import_numerical_data
workflows.intent: Import any numerical matrix (e.g., custom single-cell expression matrix) into a SingleCellExperiment object for scDataviz.
workflows.stages:
1. Create numerical matrix and metadata.
2. Import data using importData.
workflows.code:
mat <- jitter(matrix(
    MASS::rnegbin(rexp(50000, rate=.1), theta = 4.5),
    ncol = 20))
  colnames(mat) <- paste0('CD', 1:ncol(mat))
  rownames(mat) <- paste0('cell', 1:nrow(mat))

  metadata <- data.frame(
    group = rep('A', nrow(mat)),
    row.names = rownames(mat),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  head(metadata)

  sce <- importData(mat,
    assayname = 'normcounts',
    metadata = metadata)
  sce
